title: Jolly Peruvian Tofu Rocoto Relleno
description: Savory crispy tofu-filled rocoto peppers in a shrimp stock and fermented sauce, kid friendly and vegetarian.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Slice the tops off the rocoto peppers and remove seeds, leaving a cavity.
In a skillet over medium heat, sauté the tofu cubes in 1 tbsp olive oil until lightly browned, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add the fermented soybean paste and soy sauce, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the shrimp stock and let it simmer for 3 minutes until reduced slightly.
Add the sautéed tofu, cornmeal, flour, salt, pepper, and chili flakes to the sauce, mixing until the tofu is coated and the mixture thickens.
Spoon the tofu filling into each rocoto pepper cavity until full, then drizzle lime juice over the filled peppers.
Sprinkle a thin layer of cornmeal over the tops to help crisp.
Bake the filled peppers for 15 minutes, until the cornmeal is golden and the peppers are tender.
Remove from the oven, let rest 5 minutes, then serve hot.
